question: G has two daughters. P is the husband of H. H is the mother of D who is the granddaughter of G. D is the sister of M who is the nephew of K. K is the daughter of N. N is the mother-in-law of P. Then how is G related to M?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/157d2ec770237097989beb9a00ef41711bba34c2aea64333d8b7821f025c749e.png] 

According to given conditions,

1) P is the husband of H. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55ddafb464b3cce67491c105e5e16d4fc1260496755042f1011dc3aa2cc5874e.png] 

2) H is the mother of D who is the granddaughter of G.
